newsitem.title: USA: Lewis Galoob files for 2.4 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Lewis Galoob files for 2.4 mln shr offer.

text.p: Lewis Galoob Toys Inc said on Monday that it has registered to sell just under 2.4 million shares of common stock in a public offer.
Of the stock being sold, 2.0 million shares are being offered by the company and 392,866 shares by an unaffiliated holder of warrants to purchase company common stock.
Underwriters have been given a 45-day option to purchase just under 359,000 shares to cover over-allotments.
Gerard Klauer Mattison & Co. LLC will be the lead manager in the offering, and William Blair & Company and Jefferies & Co. Inc. will act as the co-managers.
Net proceeds to the company will be used to repay about $43 million in short-term debt, retire a $4.0 million mortgage and for general corporate purposes.
